checklist.note: Checklist numbers are from KeenGamer [4] and PowerPyx [2]; the trophy-vs-checklist comparison is from CryptoGames [6] (Press-Start list, 18 Nov 2026). The checklist appears in game only after the story, under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion. Progress made during the story already counts.
checklist.robberiesNote: Bank vaults unlock only in Chapter 4, through the optional mission “That’s Where The Money Is…” [2][4].

stages.focus: Play the story, enjoy it, and do the one thing that cannot wait.
stages.name: Story first
stages.warn: CH 1 ONLY — after the mission Down to Earth, Lucia meditates on the balcony at Jason’s house. Do it before Chapter 1 ends. See dispute D02.

stages.focus: Unlock co-op free roam and bank the two partner trophies while the story is still fresh.
stages.name: Partner play
stages.warn: Unlocks after Chapter 2, mission Coffee Break — that is when you can call your partner and play together.

stages.focus: The long grind. Everything here is still available after the story, so do it after the finale.
stages.name: The 100% grind
stages.warn: 100% is closer to 60% true completion [2] — most collectibles are only partly required. Follow the checklist numbers, not the totals.

stages.focus: Character questlines and stranger chains. Start each chain the moment it unlocks (see dispute D04).
stages.name: Strangers & Freaks
stages.warn: Kenton goes quiet for a while in the story and comes back in Chapter 2–3 — he is not missable [2].

stages.focus: The five unsolved trophies plus anything still open, then the platinum.
stages.name: Cleanup & platinum
stages.warn: Five trophies are still unsolved as of 21 Nov 2026 [2][5][6]. This guide shows both versions of every disputed claim instead of guessing.
